brief: Interesting character 3: desert solar-scavenger robot, kite-cloth cape, rust + mirror panels.

steps.name: concept render A (rust-dominant)
steps.prompt: Quality 3D render of a single desert solar-scavenger robot character, whole body visible and centred with margin on all sides, three-quarter front view from slightly above. Lanky bipedal scavenger bot with rust-orange weathered steel body panels, polished mirror solar-collector panels on shoulders and backpack, tattered kite-cloth cape in sand-faded teal rippling behind, round scavenger goggles, antenna with tiny solar vane. Plain light-grey uncluttered studio background, soft even lighting, no strong shadows, character turnaround style, at least 1024px short side.

steps.prompt: Quality 3D render of a single desert solar-scavenger robot character, whole body visible and centred with margin on all sides, three-quarter front view from slightly above. steps.name: hero render (balanced contrast, follows A)
steps.prompt: Quality 3D render of a single desert solar-scavenger robot hero character, whole body visible and centred with margin on all sides, three-quarter front view from slightly above.
